title: Zero declared dependencies; a Maven plugin's transitive payload generates runtime code during the build

source.exclude_note: tooling/ holds the SOURCE of the plugin and payload, co-located only so the workshop is self-contained; in real life they live in another repository, so the source stage must not see them

shipped.note: primary component; the only package in the jar

not_shipped.note: bound to generate-sources; generates GeneratedTraceRoute.java and ServiceLoader metadata
transitive dependency of the plugin; carries the /hidden/build-info route that ends up compiled into the jar
